canonical_target.normalized_claim: For natural x,p,y,q greater than one, x^p + 1 = y^q implies (x,p,y,q) = (2,3,3,2).

sources: the content-bound public-project results already recorded by the target and same-claim dossier
the primary human proof is historical evidence; no non-Lean backend is eligible for Lean 4 proof credit in this inventory
Preda Mihailescu, Primary Cyclotomic Units and a Proof of Catalan's Conjecture, J. reine angew. Math. 572 (2004), DOI 10.1515/crll.2004.048

selection_rules.exact: The candidate must preserve the Nat carrier, ordered binders, all four strict lower bounds, the plus-one orientation, and the exact tuple conclusion, or provide a checked transport to that proposition.
selection_rules.supporting: Definitions, factorization APIs, polynomial analogues, finite checks, and conditional wrappers are classified independently and never receive root proof credit.
selection_rules.placeholder: A declaration whose terminal body or transitive proof body uses sorry, admit, sorryAx, an unapproved axiom, unsafe code, or an oracle is M5 for root-credit purposes.
selection_rules.negative_evidence: Every negative lane identifies its query/source, immutable or content-bound input, observation boundary, and reopen condition. Access failure is not interpreted as a zero-result search.
selection_rules.deduplication: Aliases, wrappers, same-claim dossiers, and candidates sharing one terminal body are counted once for proof credit.

network_policy: denied for worker replay; no clone, fetch, update, dependency build, or moving-ref query is part of this version
immutable_refresh_policy: A new immutable candidate or changed source/pin creates a new append-only inventory version and invalidates this one.
